data.name: Srishti
data.gender_notes: Srishti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Srishti is a name derived from the Sanskrit and Hindi language, which means 'creation', 'manifestation', or 'establishment'. It is a popular name among Hindus and is often given to a child as a symbol of good fortune and the belief that they will bring something new and beautiful into the world. The name Srishti carries the meaning “Creation, manifestation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Srishti usually hope their child will grow to embody creation, manifestation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Srishti represents the divine power of creation and the belief that every individual has the power to create their own reality. It is a reminder that we are all connected to the universe and that our thoughts and actions have the power to shape our lives and the world around us.
data.etymology: Srishti belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Creation, manifestation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Srishti total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Srishti is associated with Hindu traditions and has cultural significance in Indian society. In Hindu mythology, the god Brahma is the creator of the universe and hence, Srishti evokes a sense of creative potential and the power to bring new things into existence. This name also carries the message of hope and the belief that every new generation has the power to create something new and beautiful in the world. Additionally, the name is a common one among Hindu communities in India and Nepal.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Srishti signifies the creative energy of the universe and the innate ability of every individual to manifest their desires and dreams. It is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the potential for growth and transformation in every moment. The name also carries the energy of the divine creator, reminding us that each of us is a unique and intricate creation of the universe. Ultimately, Srishti is a name that inspires us to see the world as a canvas for our creativity and to believe in the power of manifestation and transformation in our lives.
